name: SupplyNaira
description: Pays a Lagos importer's local suppliers the exact naira (cNGN) amount on their invoices from USDT on Celo mainnet, converting on Textile FX only when the rate meets the importer's floor. Refuses, on record, when it does not.

services.name: supplier-invoice-payment
services.description: Exact-out USDT to cNGN conversion on Textile FX with a deterministic floor-rate guard, payment to an external supplier wallet, and a public receipt per payment.
